about.description:
The Pythia program is a standard tool for the generation of events in
high-energy collisions, comprising a coherent set of physics models for
the evolution from a few-body hard process to a complex multiparticle
final state. It contains a library of hard processes, models for initial-
and final-state parton showers, matching and merging methods between hard
processes and parton showers, multiparton interactions, beam remnants,
string fragmentation and particle decays. It also has a set of utilities
and several interfaces to external programs.
about.summary: A tool for the generation of events in high-energy collisions

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  file_version: "8312"
  version: ${{ file_version[0] + "." + file_version[1:] }}
  build: 6

package:
  name: pythia8
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://gitlab.com/Pythia8/releases/-/archive/pythia${{ file_version }}/releases-pythia${{ file_version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: c1a33aa5fa15e6b70d7946ce6d237246842887ec84ea0b35dfc2535c868a2770

build:
  # Prioritize builds with a higher microarch level.
  # microarch_level 4 not supported yet.
  # c.f. https://github.com/conda-forge/microarch-level-feedstock/issues/5
  number: ${{ build + 100 * (microarch_level | default("1") | int) if unix and x86_64 else build }}
  skip: win

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: python
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - if: unix and x86_64
      then: x86_64-microarch-level ==${{ microarch_level }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - rsync
    - make
    - sed
  host:
    - python
    - if: linux and match(python, "<3.9")
      then: libxcrypt
    - pybind11
    - lhapdf
    - fastjet-cxx
    - hepmc2
    - hepmc3
    # zlib controlled through https://github.com/conda-forge/conda-forge-pinning-feedstock/
    - zlib
  run:
    - python
    # zlib needed to be compatible with cxx-compiler
    - zlib
  run_exports:
    - pythia8 >=${{ version }},<${{ file_version[0] }}.${{ (file_version[1] | int) + 1 }}00.0a0

tests:
  - package_contents:
      bin:
        - pythia8-config
      lib:
        - pythia8
      include:
        - Pythia8/Pythia.h
      files:
        exists:
          # pythia8 gives its plugin libraries a .so suffix on every
          # platform, so the lib: shorthand does not match them on macOS
          # where it looks for .dylib.
          - lib/libpythia8lhapdf6.so
          - share/Pythia8/examples/Makefile
          - share/Pythia8/examples/Makefile.inc
        not_exists:
          - share/Pythia8/htmldoc
          - share/Pythia8/pdfdoc

  - python:
      imports:
        - pythia8
  - files:
      source:
        - examples/Makefile
        - examples/main101.cc
        - examples/main131.cc
        - examples/main132.cc
        - examples/main132.cmnd
        - examples/main133.cc
        - examples/main133.cmnd
        - examples/main134.cc
        - examples/main134.cmnd
        - examples/main135.cc
        - examples/main161.cc
        - examples/main161.cmnd
        - examples/main201.cc
        - examples/main212.cc
        - examples/w+_production_lhc_0.lhe
        - examples/ttbar.lhe
        - examples/ttbar2.lhe
        - examples/wbj_lhef3.lhe
      recipe:
        - run_test.sh
    requirements:
      run:
        - cxx-compiler
        - lhapdf >=6.2
        - fastjet-cxx
        - hepmc2
        - hepmc3
        - make
        - sed
    script: bash run_test.sh

about:
  license: GPL-2.0-only
  license_file: COPYING
  summary: A tool for the generation of events in high-energy collisions
  description: |
    The Pythia program is a standard tool for the generation of events in
    high-energy collisions, comprising a coherent set of physics models for
    the evolution from a few-body hard process to a complex multiparticle
    final state. It contains a library of hard processes, models for initial-
    and final-state parton showers, matching and merging methods between hard
    processes and parton showers, multiparton interactions, beam remnants,
    string fragmentation and particle decays. It also has a set of utilities
    and several interfaces to external programs.
  homepage: https://pythia.org/
  repository: https://gitlab.com/Pythia8/releases
  documentation: https://pythia.org/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - chrisburr
    - henryiii
    - ph-ilten
    - matthewfeickert
